Summary:
The target video is an interrogation scene in a costume court intrigue drama, set in <Subject 2>, a private room of a tavern outside the palace, where <Subject 1> Li Huaiyu sits opposite a foreign merchant's lackey, pressing him about the provenance of the 千日醉 transactions.

Retention Analysis:
<Subject 1> (appearing in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): Fully retained — the Third Prince Li Huaiyu from <Image 1>, seated in fitted outfit with a piercing gaze, retained as the interrogator.
<Subject 2> (appearing in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): Fully retained — the private tavern room from <Image 2>, wooden table, wine jar, raincoat and bamboo hat, retained as the scene environment.

Detailed Description:
The target video adopts a steady, realistic Chinese-period drama style, indoor daylight with window-lattice shadows cast by the afternoon sun, dialogue restrained yet oppressive.

[Shot 1] A medium two-shot opens in <Subject 2>, the private room of the tavern. <Subject 1>, the Third Prince Li Huaiyu from <Image 1>, sits by the window, idly turning a coarse clay wine cup in his hand, but his gaze is cold and fixed on the man opposite as he speaks slowly, [中文，语速放缓] 千日醉，西域奇毒。你卖了三次，前两次买主本殿查清了，第三次，卖给了谁？
[Shot 2] At 00:08.000, the camera cuts to a medium close-up of <Subject 1> (S1). He sets down the cup, takes a copper coin from his bosom and flicks it between his fingers; the coin spins endlessly on the wooden table as he says in a low voice, [中文，语速放缓] 想清楚了再说。说错一个字，这间酒肆，你就出不去了。

Overall Soundscape:
Faint clamor of the street market drifting through the window, the slosh of wine, the humming of the spinning copper coin on wood, a silence taut with tension.

Non-Diegetic Music:
Low pipa tremolo accompaniment, sparse and oppressive, with a short string note at the moment the coin spins.
